logic.note: Sounds while ≥ 3 V is applied with the right polarity.

timing.note: Starts and stops instantly; the internal ~2.3 kHz oscillator is not simulated cycle by cycle and there is no audio output yet.

analog.note: Modelled as a 180 Ω load (≈ 25 mA at 5 V) with a reverse-blocking diode; loudness ramps linearly from 3 V to 5 V.

power.note: Current draw is realistic for a 5 V active buzzer, so GPIO overcurrent checks apply.

emulates: An info diagnostic (buzzer-tone) when it is driven with tone() / PWM
doesNotEmulate: The rough sound when driven with PWM / tone() (it is flagged, not modelled; use passive-buzzer for notes)
testOnRealDevice: Driving with tone() or PWM (active buzzers can sound distorted)
